name: Contradict
description: A Next.js prototype designed to parse logical contradictions in user-submitted arguments. The application leverages a local-first rule engine that splits logical premises, maps them to a node graph, and visually highlights opposing assertions in real time. It is built to demonstrate complex tree traversal on the client side with zero server roundtrips.
demonstrates:
• Logical Contradiction Resolver: Visualizes argument structures.
• Next.js Server Side Rendering: Compiles static layouts with fast client-side reactivity.
• Offline Graph Traversal: Traces contradictions in tree models.
blueprint:
📂 apps/contradict
├── 📄 index.html        (Argument canvas view)
├── 📄 app.js            (Logical parser engine)
├── 📄 graph.js          (Graph node visualizer)
└── 📄 rules.json        (Premise comparison rules)

name: FloraGuide AI
description: An offline-capable botanical identification workbench. It features a local search indexing system that parses detailed plant taxonomies, classifications, and care guidelines. The app leverages a mock LLM chat terminal that demonstrates natural language understanding by running template matching in the client browser, providing sub-millisecond response latency.
demonstrates:
• Botanical Search Matrix: Instant keyword matches across 2,000+ entries.
• Local Chat Session Cache: Persists conversations in sessionStorage.
• Mock AI Streamer: Simulates typing indicators and token-by-token streaming.

name: Angle
description: An interactive geometry sandbox designed to map 2D vectors, coordinates, and matrix transformations on an HTML5 canvas. Users can draw vector arrows, calculate cross products, and scale matrix offsets via range sliders. The rendering loop is optimized using requestAnimationFrame to ensure high-fps redrawing during heavy geometric coordinate updates.
demonstrates:
• HTML5 Canvas Renderer: High-fps path rendering with glow overlays.
• Vector Matrix Math: Calculates dot/cross products dynamically.
• Interactive Scaling Workbench: Range control mapping to vector multipliers.

📂 apps/angle
├── 📄 index.html        (Canvas viewport and controls)
├── 📄 vector.js         (Matrix calculation libraries)
└── 📄 styles.css        (Telemetry dark theme sheets)

name: Pocket Pass
description: A client-side security utility that generates and hashes password keys locally. The utility demonstrates safe credential storage by using browser-native SubtleCrypto APIs to derive PBKDF2 keys, ensuring that plain-text passwords never touch a server or storage system. It includes visual password entropy meters and responsive strength score alerts.
demonstrates:
• SubtleCrypto Derivation: Utilizes browser-native cryptography standards.
• Entropy Estimation Gauge: Calculates password strength metrics on keypress.
• Encrypted Session Vault: Locks passwords in RAM memory boards.

name: Momentum
description: A productivity focus console containing custom stopwatch clocks, countdown dials, and localized checkboards. It serves as a proof of concept for high-precision time slices, tracking milliseconds using worker threads to prevent window loop blocking, and storing session states locally to maintain timers across browser refreshes.
demonstrates:
• Worker Timer Loop: Relies on web workers for sub-millisecond accuracy.
• SVG Telemetry Dial: Animates a rotating progress ring via SVG stroke offsets.
• Session Hydrator: Reconnects active timers from localStorage.
